name: ether.fi AtomicQueue unauthenticated solver
summary: AtomicQueue.solve takes the solver as a caller-supplied argument and pulls the want token from it via transferFrom without requiring solver == msg.sender. The attacker registered its own request with a worthless offer token and an atomicPrice equal to each victim's balance, then named third-party wallets holding standing liquidETH or USDC allowances to the queue as solvers, draining them. Copycats repeated it within two hours against sETHFI, weETHs, eEIGEN, liquidUSD and liquidElixir allowances.

loss.notes: Exact gross depletion of 62 third-party allowance holders across source-1 and eight later copycat transactions (source-7); worthless fake offer tokens credited to victims are not netted. Liquid assets use DefiLlama quotes; liquidElixir (no quote) uses realised proceeds of the last copycat's disposal, so the aggregate method is other. The first attacker's realised 15.4536 ETH from liquidETH does not set the liquidETH valuation.

ageReset.description: Immutable AtomicQueue runtime with no owner or settable state other than user requests; solve's missing solver authentication exists from deployment.

sources.note: Anchor, root cause and first exercise. Source-1: status 1, block 25952624 index 8, ts 1789111211, a CREATE by EOA 0xa5cc6e490bce9185fa47b421f2eac677a83b64ea (created 0x7f5a5f66ebf8afc301ffe3739305c356b110dec1, whose constructor deploys worker 0x679c53ff03c5c60aac538a019ca9d69c5dfa663e and fake offer token 0xd9b51a9b11b6af45750bfe06d0459fdce0d03f64). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): the worker makes 11 CALLs to AtomicQueue 0xd45884b592e316eb816199615a95c182f75dea07 with solve selector 0xd93fc203 whose fifth argument (solver) is a third-party account, not the caller: 0x69da2912..., 0x1226c763..., 0xee8d39ab..., 0x0eacbaa9..., 0x13b90df2..., 0x0ec7e8c2..., 0x516e726f..., 0x4d4ef453..., 0x2cfb075e... (liquidETH) and 0x047e7cfa..., 0xeabf4c3e... (USDC); each preceded by updateAtomicRequest 0x7c88eaa1 (AtomicRequestUpdated 0x9537495a) setting the worker's request for fake offer -> want with offerAmount 1e18 and atomicPrice = amount to pull. The queue then CALLs finishSolve 0x2ddd62ce on the victim (a smart-wallet/7702 account delegating to e.g. 0x000100abaad02f1cfc8bbe32bd5a564817339e72 whose handler returns without reverting) and executes want.transferFrom(victim, worker, assetsToUser) using the victim's standing allowance to the queue: receipt liquidETH Transfer logs 58,61,64,67,70,74,77,80,83 and USDC logs 86,89, each followed by AtomicRequestFulfilled 0xa4e3f90e (logs 59..90). Source-5 solve() never binds solver to msg.sender or to any consent, so any address with a want allowance to the queue can be named as the paying solver. Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 logs.getLogs on the queue, topic0 0xa4e3f90ef19273220b37cbbbcfe402a6eadd9559c54813b9be52ea0c9612d6c9, blocks 0..99999999 (paged, then fromBlock 25953200 to head 26078651) returns 86346 events in 6955 transactions, last at block 25953207. For the 6946 transactions before source-1, eth_getTransactionReceipt and matching each event's want Transfer(solver -> user, wantAmountReceived) immediately preceding it identifies the paying solver for all 86284 pre-exploit events (0 unmatched): 0x989468982b08aefa46e37cd0086142a86fa466d7 (64368, tx.to = solver), 0x566bfa809b88967c994d77ed924bebffe80bd00c (13004, tx.to = solver), AtomicSolverV2 0x5b744e93bbf5caf38df34f3ba14a40024d1a2d7a (8352, via Safe 0x41dfc53b...), 0x1cc0190bc4aaf0ec682868cd4db7f60e64707b6f (515, via Safe 0x71e2d6c3...), 0x44df4411ff7797557f816d15d36c9a6dffe38bbe (44, 9 direct calls by 0x0000006fe7000580760dc706e4a1d5bed5f732ea, which created that solver at block 21600035) and 0x793296c0b11fd9bb65211ac61aaca82885eb2cab (1, block 19515929, direct call by queue deployer 0x2322ba43eff1542b6a7baed35e66099ea0d12bd1, its creator). All pre-exploit solvers are the caller's own solver contracts paying legitimate vault-share redemptions; offer tokens are ether.fi/Seven Seas vault shares. Source-1 is the first solve naming a non-consenting solver and the first fake offer token (0xd9b51a9b). Later campaigns by other actors against the same queue are merged as loss (source-6/source-7).

Verified AtomicQueue source (Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=1 address 0xd45884b592e316eb816199615a95c182f75dea07): ContractName AtomicQueue, compiler v0.8.21+commit.d9974bed, optimizer 200 runs, standard-JSON sources src/modules/atomic-queue/AtomicQueue.sol, IAtomicSolver.sol, src/utils/Math.sol and solmate SafeTransferLib/ERC20/ReentrancyGuard; SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode string b65fbc9c8c4f8bcd42f75610671729145741d1d15ead6662fee5a2995624e722. Inspect solve(ERC20 offer, ERC20 want, address[] users, bytes runData, address solver): offer.safeTransferFrom(users[i], solver, offerAmount); IAtomicSolver(solver).finishSolve(...); want.safeTransferFrom(solver, users[i], offerAmount*atomicPrice/10**offerDecimals), with price and amount taken from the caller-controlled request of updateAtomicRequest and no check that solver == msg.sender.

Loss: gross third-party want-token depletion across all solve() calls naming non-consenting solvers (eth_getTransactionReceipt; Transfer(from=victim solver, to=user) immediately before each AtomicRequestFulfilled). Campaign 1, source-1 (0xa5cc6e49...): liquidETH 12366762997907905993 + 1872359702113513087 + 108561548097609073 + 71654265569543118 + 10559405683080560 + 9912991721213508 + 3565365329596464 + 1606368347210355 + 558441856808074 = 14445541086626480232 from 9 victims; USDC 5692181 + 1355667 = 7047848 from 2 victims. The worker sold the liquidETH on Uniswap V4 (logs 93/96/99) for 15.4536 ETH per source-2. Later actors (source-7, all solve with a fresh fake offer and a victim as solver): 0xa53b2cdd... block 25952797 and 0x4e4f53f3... block 25952798 by EOA 0x41a1d3ec1aa6c2d35a3c20a378b7b1d10137f27b via 0xa8994a26b207590b5146d80730100ee5c74490c2: sETHFI 358300000000000000000 from 0xbb1a131e9c50f6016a1ed12c818646411979a565, weETHs 101468198426629164 from 0xb312665792d45a3884e605e8b7626ad5b09d66a1 (swept to 0x183de46305d68a5fad44bc43c7a00b8fd0072bbd at blocks 25952845/25952853); 0x3b1e96df... block 25952956 (CREATE by 0x1cac5af9780a1776e449ffdef23331efd267166c): sETHFI 16346840963917834699 + 1000000000000000000; 0x3ad0febf... block 25952978, 0x96a9aa65... block 25953041, 0xbb09904f... block 25953181 by EOA 0xfc3facd67138966ab0c841e905b0c4bca1abe92f: eEIGEN 55424623826341307371, liquidElixir 297188890286777372830, liquidUSD 3405987; 0xccfadbb8... block 25953172 (CREATE by 0x91138476a3fde4bf69c253c134b1647377348b5b): liquidETH 257660034644643 + 221697287246775, weETHs 117662218970766 + 100964142217646; 0xcd5495ad... block 25953207 index 212, ts 1789118219 (CREATE by 0x8cc42905e3ef2a24b855b803ce3d5bb121a50a80): liquidElixir from 40 victims totalling 3658729120222188156. No AtomicRequestFulfilled exists after block 25953207 through head 26078651. Etherscan V2 account.tokentx (blocks 25952600..99999999) for 0xa5cc6e49..., 0x41a1d3ec..., 0xa8994a26..., 0x183de463..., 0x1cac5af9..., 0xfc3facd6..., 0x91138476... and 0x8cc42905... shows no drained token returned to a victim; 0x183de463 sold the 358.3 sETHFI into Uniswap V4 at block 25953742. Totals: liquidETH 14446020443948371650, sETHFI 375646840963917834699, weETHs 101686824787817576, eEIGEN 55424623826341307371, liquidElixir 300847619406999560986 (18 decimals), USDC 7047848, liquidUSD 3405987 (6 decimals; decimals() views at block 25952623). Attacker fake offer tokens paid to victims are worthless and not netted. Liquid assets use DefiLlama quotes nearest each asset's first drain. liquidElixir has no DefiLlama quote: in 0xcd5495ad the actor sold 3.658729120222188156 liquidElixir (log 1280) and received 1486835848516 + 72449787404554 = 73936623253070 wei WETH (logs 1292, 1296), valued at source-14 WETH 2475.534036227203 USD: 0.0500262854593529 USD per liquidElixir.

Identity and age. Direct immutable contract: AtomicQueue 0xd45884b592e316eb816199615a95c182f75dea07, created top-level in source-4 (block 19450598 index 14, ts 1710630311) by EOA 0x2322ba43eff1542b6a7baed35e66099ea0d12bd1 (eth_getCode empty). eth_getCode at 19450597 is 0x; keccak256 of runtime (5944 bytes) = 0xeaf30cec4c199a0c3a3391b7cff73e94fd54372445c138d2e79f03c0333ff4fb at 19450598, 25952623 and 26078000. Source-5: no owner, auth, upgrade, selfdestruct or settable parameter exists (ReentrancyGuard only; state is only userAtomicRequest). The solver-authentication defect is in the deployed runtime and no configuration value bears on it, so deployment is the age basis: 1789111211 - 1710630311 = 78480900 s (2.49 years).
